params.name: start_date
params.description: Start date (inclusive) of first activity. Specified in ISO-8601 format, for example `2018-08-06T23:13:55.997Z`

params.name: end_date
params.description: End date (exclusive) of last activity. Specified in ISO-8601 format, for example `2018-08-06T23:13:55.997Z`

params.name: page
params.description:
The page number for [paginated results](/products/payments-odl/api-docs/ripplenet/best-practices/pagination/). The value is zero-based, where `0` represents the first page.
Set it to `0` to get the first page of results.

params.name: size
params.description: Number of liquidations to return per page.

items.docs: List all liquidations by date range

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier of the liquidation. Obtain this value by performing a [GET liquidations](#operation/getLiquidations) operation.

items.docs: Get a specific liquidation by its unique `Id` value

params.name: ripplenet_payment_id
params.description: Unique identifier for a RippleNet payment. Obtain this value by performing a [GET liquidations](#operation/getLiquidations) operation.

items.docs: Get a list of liquidations associated with a `ripplenet_payment_id`
